rebuttal_or_critique: While I maintain that a neutral stance is more appropriate given the benign core inflation of 3.10% and the supply-side nature of food price shocks, I recognize the committee's strong emphasis on anchoring inflation expectations amidst the 8.69% food inflation print. To ensure a unified signal that maintains the credibility of our inflation-targeting framework, I am willing to align with the majority on the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance for this meeting, while continuing to advocate for a data-dependent approach that avoids unnecessary over-tightening as the output gap remains only marginally positive.
